action.name: Execute Javascript
action.param: "if (!document.getElementById('fredoka-class-style')) { var style = document.createElement('style'); style.id = 'fredoka-class-style'; style.innerHTML = '.fredoka-style { font-family: Fredoka, sans-serif !important; font-size: 2.5vh !important; }'; document.head.appendChild(style); } var ids = ['NamaPlayerID', 'RankID', 'NamaPlayerHeader', 'EXPReqID']; ids.forEach(function(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) { el.classList.add('fredoka-style'); } });"

action.name: Execute Javascript
action.param: "var rankEl = document.getElementById('RankID'); if (rankEl) { rankEl.style.fontFamily = 'Fredoka'; rankEl.style.fontSize = '2.5vh'; if (" & LevelPlayer & " >= 50) { rankEl.innerHTML = 'Rank MAX'; } else { rankEl.innerHTML = 'Rank ' + " & LevelPlayer & "; } } var expEl = document.getElementById('EXPReqID'); if (expEl) { if (" & LevelPlayer & " >= 50) { expEl.innerHTML = 'Anda memiliki ' + " & Experience & " + ' EXP'; } else { expEl.innerHTML = 'Butuh ' + " & (ExperienceNextLevel - Experience) & " + ' EXP Untuk Naik Level'; } }"
